raw_market.question: 2Q Spread: Notre Dame (-10.5)
raw_market.description:
In the second quarter of the college football game between Stanford and Notre Dame, scheduled for October 10 at 3:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Notre Dame" if Notre Dame outscore Stanford by 11 or more points in the second quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Stanford".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
